-- Aggregate at order grain first: AVG(order revenue) is independent of the
-- number of lines in an order; one discounted line marks the whole order.
-- The customer dimension anchors the result, including customers with no sales:
-- their order counts are zero and revenue/AOV remain NULL.
select
    coalesce(expected.customer_id, actual.customer_id) as customer_id,
    expected.total_orders as expected_total_orders,
    actual.total_orders as actual_total_orders,
    expected.orders_with_discount as expected_discounted_orders,
    actual.orders_with_discount as actual_discounted_orders,
    expected.total_revenue as expected_total_revenue,
    actual.total_revenue as actual_total_revenue,
    expected.avg_order_value as expected_avg_order_value,
    actual.avg_order_value as actual_avg_order_value
from (
    select
        customers.customer_id,
        1 as expected_present,
        count(orders.sales_order_id) as total_orders,
        sum(orders.order_revenue) as total_revenue,
        avg(orders.order_revenue) as avg_order_value,
        count(case when orders.discounted = 1 then orders.sales_order_id end) as orders_with_discount
    from "AdventureWorks2014"."silver"."slvr_customers" as customers
    left join (
        select
            customer_id,
            sales_order_id,
            sum(line_total) as order_revenue,
            max(has_discount) as discounted
        from "AdventureWorks2014"."silver"."slvr_sales_orders"
        group by customer_id, sales_order_id
    ) as orders on orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
    group by customers.customer_id
) as expected
full outer join (
    select *, 1 as actual_present
    from "AdventureWorks2014"."gold"."gld_customer_metrics"
) as actual on actual.customer_id = expected.customer_id
where expected.expected_present is null
    or actual.actual_present is null
    or exists (
        select expected.total_orders, expected.orders_with_discount
        except
        select actual.total_orders, actual.orders_with_discount
    )
    or (expected.total_revenue is null and actual.total_revenue is not null)
    or (expected.total_revenue is not null and actual.total_revenue is null)
    or abs(expected.total_revenue - actual.total_revenue) > 0.01
    or (expected.avg_order_value is null and actual.avg_order_value is not null)
    or (expected.avg_order_value is not null and actual.avg_order_value is null)
    or abs(expected.avg_order_value - actual.avg_order_value) > 0.01

  from "AdventureWorks2014"."bronze"."brnz_sales_orders"
),

validation_errors as (

  from meet_condition
  where

    1 = 2
    -- records with a value >= min_value are permitted. The `not` flips this to find records that don't meet the rule.
    or not unit_price_discount >= 0
    -- records with a value <= max_value are permitted. The `not` flips this to find records that don't meet the rule.
    or not unit_price_discount <= 1
)

from validation_errors

-- One Gold row must exist per Silver order date. Channel metrics count orders,
-- not order lines. Compare each date independently so offsetting errors fail.
select
    coalesce(expected.order_date, actual.order_date) as order_date,
    expected.total_orders as expected_total_orders,
    actual.total_orders as actual_total_orders,
    expected.online_orders as expected_online_orders,
    actual.online_orders as actual_online_orders,
    expected.offline_orders as expected_offline_orders,
    actual.offline_orders as actual_offline_orders,
    expected.total_revenue as expected_total_revenue,
    actual.total_revenue as actual_total_revenue
from (
    select
        cast(order_date as date) as order_date,
        count_big(*) as source_line_count,
        count(distinct sales_order_id) as total_orders,
        count(distinct case when order_channel = 'Online' then sales_order_id end) as online_orders,
        count(distinct case when order_channel = 'Offline' then sales_order_id end) as offline_orders,
        sum(line_total) as total_revenue
    from "AdventureWorks2014"."silver"."slvr_sales_orders"
    group by cast(order_date as date)
) as expected
full outer join (
    select *, 1 as actual_present
    from "AdventureWorks2014"."gold"."gld_sales_summary"
) as actual on actual.order_date = expected.order_date
where expected.source_line_count is null
    or actual.actual_present is null
    or exists (
        select expected.total_orders, expected.online_orders, expected.offline_orders
        except
        select actual.total_orders, actual.online_orders, actual.offline_orders
    )
    or actual.online_orders + actual.offline_orders <> actual.total_orders
    or (expected.total_revenue is null and actual.total_revenue is not null)
    or (expected.total_revenue is not null and actual.total_revenue is null)
    or abs(expected.total_revenue - actual.total_revenue) > 0.01

-- Silver must preserve exactly the eligible Bronze lines, not the unfiltered
-- Bronze row count. Keys/duplicates/required NULLs have separate schema tests.
-- EXCEPT compares forwarded values NULL-safely, including nullable ship_date.
select
    coalesce(expected.sales_order_id, actual.sales_order_id) as sales_order_id,
    coalesce(expected.order_detail_id, actual.order_detail_id) as order_detail_id,
    expected.expected_present,
    actual.actual_present,
    expected.line_total as expected_line_total,
    actual.line_total as actual_line_total,
    expected.order_qty as expected_order_qty,
    actual.order_qty as actual_order_qty
from (
    select *, 1 as expected_present
    from "AdventureWorks2014"."bronze"."brnz_sales_orders"
    where order_qty > 0 and unit_price >= 0
) as expected
full outer join (
    select *, 1 as actual_present
    from "AdventureWorks2014"."silver"."slvr_sales_orders"
) as actual
    on actual.sales_order_id = expected.sales_order_id
    and actual.order_detail_id = expected.order_detail_id
where expected.expected_present is null
    or actual.actual_present is null
    or exists (
        select
            expected.customer_id, expected.product_id,
            expected.order_date, expected.due_date, expected.ship_date,
            expected.order_qty, expected.unit_price,
            expected.unit_price_discount, expected.line_total,
            case when expected.online_order_flag = 1 then 'Online' else 'Offline' end,
            case when expected.unit_price_discount > 0 then 1 else 0 end
        except
        select
            actual.customer_id, actual.product_id,
            actual.order_date, actual.due_date, actual.ship_date,
            actual.order_qty, actual.unit_price,
            actual.unit_price_discount, actual.line_total,
            actual.order_channel, actual.has_discount
    )
    or actual.gross_amount is null
    or abs(actual.gross_amount - expected.unit_price * expected.order_qty) > 0.01
    or (expected.line_total is null and actual.effective_unit_price is not null)
    or (expected.line_total is not null and actual.effective_unit_price is null)
    or abs(actual.effective_unit_price - expected.line_total / nullif(expected.order_qty, 0)) > 0.0001

-- Decimal arithmetic preserves sub-cent differences at the tolerance boundary.
-- Missing inputs are left to separate not_null tests, not treated as zero.
select
    "order_qty",
    "unit_price",
    "unit_price_discount",
    "line_total"
from "AdventureWorks2014"."bronze"."brnz_sales_orders"
where "order_qty" is not null
  and "unit_price" is not null
  and "unit_price_discount" is not null
  and "line_total" is not null
  and abs(
      cast("line_total" as decimal(28, 8))
      - cast(
          cast("order_qty" as decimal(18, 6))
          * cast("unit_price" as decimal(18, 6))
          * (cast(1 as decimal(9, 6)) - cast("unit_price_discount" as decimal(9, 6)))
          as decimal(28, 8)
      )
  ) > cast(0.01 as decimal(28, 8))

-- Reconcile per product, never SUM(total_orders) across products: one order can
-- contain several products. Profit uses the current dimension standard_cost.
-- No sales: counts=0, SUM metrics=NULL, margin=0 (existing contract).
-- Sales with zero revenue: margin=NULL because the percentage is undefined.
select
    coalesce(expected.product_id, actual.product_id) as product_id,
    expected.total_orders as expected_total_orders,
    actual.total_orders as actual_total_orders,
    expected.total_quantity_sold as expected_quantity,
    actual.total_quantity_sold as actual_quantity,
    expected.total_revenue as expected_revenue,
    actual.total_revenue as actual_revenue,
    expected.total_profit as expected_profit,
    actual.total_profit as actual_profit,
    expected.profit_margin_pct as expected_margin,
    actual.profit_margin_pct as actual_margin
from (
    select
        products.product_id,
        1 as expected_present,
        coalesce(sales.total_orders, 0) as total_orders,
        sales.total_quantity_sold,
        sales.total_revenue,
        sales.total_revenue - sales.total_quantity_sold * products.standard_cost as total_profit,
        case
            when sales.total_quantity_sold > 0 then
                (sales.total_revenue - sales.total_quantity_sold * products.standard_cost)
                    / nullif(sales.total_revenue, 0) * 100
            else 0
        end as profit_margin_pct
    from "AdventureWorks2014"."silver"."slvr_products" as products
    left join (
        select
            product_id,
            count(distinct sales_order_id) as total_orders,
            sum(order_qty) as total_quantity_sold,
            sum(line_total) as total_revenue
        from "AdventureWorks2014"."silver"."slvr_sales_orders"
        group by product_id
    ) as sales on sales.product_id = products.product_id
) as expected
full outer join (
    select *, 1 as actual_present
    from "AdventureWorks2014"."gold"."gld_product_performance"
) as actual on actual.product_id = expected.product_id
where expected.expected_present is null
    or actual.actual_present is null
    or exists (
        select expected.total_orders, expected.total_quantity_sold
        except
        select actual.total_orders, actual.total_quantity_sold
    )
    or (expected.total_revenue is null and actual.total_revenue is not null)
    or (expected.total_revenue is not null and actual.total_revenue is null)
    or abs(expected.total_revenue - actual.total_revenue) > 0.01
    or (expected.total_profit is null and actual.total_profit is not null)
    or (expected.total_profit is not null and actual.total_profit is null)
    or abs(expected.total_profit - actual.total_profit) > 0.01
    or (expected.profit_margin_pct is null and actual.profit_margin_pct is not null)
    or (expected.profit_margin_pct is not null and actual.profit_margin_pct is null)
    or abs(expected.profit_margin_pct - actual.profit_margin_pct) > 0.0001
